Chapter 908: Chapter 11: The Descent of Demon Abyss (Please Subscribe)

“Where is this place?”

The figure in the beast robe was somewhat bewildered; he remembered that he had secretly intruded into the training area of Yun Zhenzi’s cave mansion.

But now?

All around, heaven and earth.

Vast and boundless.

The first thought of the figure in the beast robe was whether he had fallen into some kind of Illusionary Array.

But he immediately dismissed the idea.

Even the most powerful Illusionary Array is, after all, just an illusion.

Deceiving the perception of an ordinary Jade Immortal was one thing.

But for him, a Jade Immortal… the incredibly realistic space-time fluctuations all around him.

Made the figure in the beast robe realize, this was not an illusion at all.

It was real space-time.

“Jiezi World, this is a Jiezi World created by a top Jade Immortal.”

The figure in the beast robe finally remembered something.

Top Jade Immortals, when comprehending the mysteries of space-time and spending long periods in seclusion, could affect the area.

Causing phenomena similar to a Spatial-Temporal Maze to form.

This is the Jiezi World.

However.

In the knowledge of the figure in the beast robe.

Even the Jiezi Worlds formed by the Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s Direct Disciples, who were in seclusion for years,

Were at most a few thousand or ten thousand miles in range, how could it be as vast and endless as it is now?

This is also why the figure in the beast robe did not initially think of the Jiezi World.

The Jiezi World before him differed too greatly from the normal Jiezi World.

“What kind of existence could form a Jiezi World on such a scale?”

The figure in the beast robe’s mind trembled; although there was no set standard for the size of a Jiezi World, it must relate to the depth of the original Jade Immortal’s comprehension of space-time mysteries.

Normally speaking, the more vast the Jiezi World and the more complex the Spatial-Temporal Maze, the more terrifying the original Jade Immortal’s insight into the mysteries of space-time.

And who could correspond to the Jiezi World in front of him?

The figure in the beast robe dared not imagine.

Rumbling.

Before the figure in the beast robe could make any movement,

The space-time around him began to ripple, and like a lone boat in the vast sea, he was submerged under the sea in an instant.

“Which number is this?”

In the center of the training area, Lin Yuan opened his eyes, with all the numerous treasures and battle loot from the figure in the beast robe appearing before him.

Ever since ten years ago, when he revealed his skills as a top Alchemy Master, every so often, there would be mysterious Jade Immortals secretly infiltrating his cave mansion.

Wishing to ascend to the heavens in one step, to slay him, this top Alchemy Master, and obtain massive wealth.

But unfortunately,

Most of these mysterious Jade Immortals couldn’t even withstand the Spatial-Temporal Maze unintentionally influenced by Lin Yuan while he comprehended the Space-Time Rule, let alone survive.

They provided Lin Yuan with a windfall. Those mysterious Jade Immortals who had the capability to traverse the defenses of the Immortal City’s killing arrays were undoubtedly powerful, at least starting from top Jade Immortals, and their true combat power was terrifying, far surpassing Jade Immortals like Yun Zhenzi.

Such Jade Immortals naturally possessed significant wealth, one alone could suffice for Lin Yuan to refine numerous Immortal Pills.

“This is even more efficient than alchemy.” Lin Yuan thought to himself, but also understood that the benefits brought by alchemy were long-term and stable.

As for these mysterious Jade Immortals infiltrating his cave mansion? In the short term, one might come after another, but over time, with Lin Yuan remaining unscathed,

Other Jade Immortals with designs on Lin Yuan would start to sense something amiss. A large number of mysterious Jade Immortals dying within Lin Yuan’s cave mansion, even if not spread outside,

But Lin Yuan’s being alive and well was proof enough. Being able to cultivate to a Jade Immortal, none were fools; they would certainly deduce that Lin Yuan had an unpredictable trump card.

“Let’s take a look at these battle loots.”

Lin Yuan diverted a shred of his mind to take stock of the numerous treasures obtained from the figure in the beast robe.

…

Flying Immortal Hall.

The Hall Master’s expression changed slightly, as his gaze turned toward the Grade A Cave Mansion Area, specifically, to the Grade A Cave Mansion where Lin Yuan resided.

“Another Jade Immortal has infiltrated Master Yun Zhenzi’s cave mansion?” The Flying Immortal Hall Master had long been used to this.

The Flying Immortal Hall is an essential institute of the Cangwu Immortal City, having absolute control over all the array and killing formations in the Cave Mansion Area.

Moreover, due to the cooperative relationship with Lin Yuan, the Flying Immortal Hall Master had long focused the large array in the Cave Mansion Area particularly on Lin Yuan’s mansion.

Those Jade Immortals who quietly infiltrated Lin Yuan’s cave mansion, believing themselves to be silent, but a good number were detected in advance by the Flying Immortal Hall Master.

When the Flying Immortal Hall Master first discovered a mysterious Jade Immortal infiltrating Lin Yuan’s cave mansion, he was extremely nervous, immediately mobilized all the array formations in the Cave Mansion Area to lock down space-time, and then rushed to the outside of the cave mansion in person to probe whether Lin Yuan was still there at the time.

Only to see Lin Yuan emerge unharmed from the cave mansion, clearly stating that no Jade Immortal had infiltrated it.

At first, the Flying Immortal Hall Master thought Lin Yuan was being coerced, but after repeated exchanges, even taking Lin Yuan out of the Cave Mansion Area, it remained the same.

He could only leave helplessly, feeling that there might be a problem with the Immortal City’s big array, and that no Jade Immortal had actually infiltrated the cave mansion.

But then came the second, the third…

In the earlier instances, the Flying Immortal Hall Master was still very concerned about Lin Yuan’s safety, but every time, no discoveries were made, and Lin Yuan remained fine without encountering any danger.

As it happened more often, the Flying Immortal Hall Master felt there was something wrong.

“I didn’t expect Master Yun Zhenzi to be so deeply unassuming.” The Vice Hall Master couldn’t help but speak up.

If it was just once or twice, it might really be a problem with the array, but after so many times, even the Vice Hall Master realized something.

If the array was correct, then there truly were ill-intentioned Jade Immortals infiltrating the cave mansion.

But in the end, Lin Yuan remained unharmed, and even though they didn’t know exactly what happened in the middle, they could infer the process from the result and the beginning.
